It requires declared Portuguese or Spanish and refuses French person-directed insult frames. Bare, disguised and every separate occurrence retain high-severity screening. Round7b coordinator rule: pinto clears only as the Portuguese verb pintar. The construction starts the text or a sentence, or directly follows eu, e, que or como, and is followed by a direct object from a finite painting-object inventory (pinto a parede, pinto as unhas, pinto cada peça, pinto à mão). It never follows a determiner, possessive or verb, and no bare noun, pronoun or preposition frame exists, so meu pinto na mão or tire o pinto da calça stay withheld. The grammar, not the client-declared locale, is the guard, and the four development rows that cleared as global phrases in every locale keep passing in every locale. Right bound: the phrase must end the text or a clause, or continue only with a closed list of painting tails (a colour, tinta, corante, pincel, aquarela, care words), so Pinto a mão chupa and any person, child, body, sexual or leering continuation keep screening; a sentence holding dela, gostosa, calcinha, biquíni, chupa and the like never clears.

Round7b coordinator rule: bumbum clears only inside fit-copy frames led by the garment or a fit word (calça valoriza o bumbum, legging que levanta o bumbum, jeans de cintura alta que modela o bumbum) or as a garment-detail location (bolsos no bumbum). Underwear and swimwear nouns never lead a frame, and teu, seu, meu, minha, quero and imperative or possessive person frames are rejected, so quero ver teu bumbum no biquíni or empina o bumbum pra mim stay withheld. Right bound: the phrase must end the text or a clause, or continue only with a closed list of fit-copy tails (sem marcar, com conforto, e as coxas); any person, child, family, body, sexual or leering continuation fails the clearance, as does a sentence that holds dela, gostosa, calcinha, biquíni, chupa, mim or a child word.
